name: Maine Community Solar
old_description: Join Maine Community Solar and save 15% on your electric bill.
about:
Maine Community Solar operates from Portland, Maine, as a locally-owned company founded by Tony Napolitano. The firm was established to advance renewable energy adoption across the state by connecting residents and businesses with community solar programs.

The company provides enrollment assistance and education for community solar programs, helping customers subscribe to local solar farms without installing panels on their own properties. Its customer relations team guides clients through the signup process, which the company says takes about five minutes, and continues to provide support after enrollment. The firm reports assisting hundreds of Mainers in joining state community solar programs.

Clients include both residential and commercial customers. Restaurant groups, nonprofit organizations such as the Maine State Society for the Protection of Animals, and condominium residents who cannot install rooftop panels have all enrolled through the service. The company works with multiple solar farm developers to match customers with available capacity.

Napolitano frames the business as a mission-driven effort to make Maine a leader in sustainability. The company emphasizes honest communication, pressure-free enrollment, and ongoing customer support as distinguishing factors, with representatives often cited by name in customer testimonials for their responsiveness.
